verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS AI video platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Synthesia's source code is published or openly licensed. The pack documents only proprietary hosted features, APIs, webhooks and an MCP integration, none of which amounts to open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
